name: Helion Energy
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
description: Helion Energy is privately held and has no ticker. Review the price of each funding round, its investors, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Helion Energy is a privately held fusion energy company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a Series G round announced on June 4, 2026, valued the company at $15.5 billion; the round reached $500 million at its final close in September 2026.

Founded in 2013 and based in Everett, Washington, Helion is developing fusion power plants to generate electricity without carbon emissions and is building its first plant, Orion, in Malaga, Washington. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
table_note: Valuations are post-money. The Series G and Series F valuations are as announced by the company, and the Series E valuation is as reported by Axios. The Series G closed at $500 million in September 2026, up from $465 million at its announcement, and the Series E amount excludes $1.7 billion of further commitments tied to performance milestones.
round_notes: Thrive Capital led the Series G. Helion has said the proceeds will be used to accelerate the commercial deployment of fusion power and to expand its manufacturing capacity.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Thrive Capital led the Series G, which added Lux Capital, Peak XV Partners, BoxGroup and Alta Park Capital as new investors. Lightspeed Venture Partners and SoftBank Vision Fund 2 joined in the Series F, Nucor made a strategic investment in 2023, and Sam Altman led the Series E. Other investors include Capricorn Investment Group, Mithril Capital and Dustin Moskovitz.
spv_sentence: SEC filings show one special purpose vehicle formed to invest in Helion, organized in 2026.
sources: Sources: Helion's announcements of its Series G (June 4, 2026, updated September 2026), Series F and Series E; Nucor's announcement of September 27, 2023; Goodwin (September 2026); a report by SiliconANGLE (June 2026); reports by Axios; and SEC Form D filings.
